paragraphs: The Z4 sDrive30i has been part of the Z4 range since 2006, and across its three generations has used three different petrol engines — from the naturally aspirated N52 through to today's turbocharged B48. The full breakdown by engine code is below.
about.boldParagraph: The Z4 sDrive30i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre naturally aspirated inline-six fitted to the Z4 sDrive30i from 2006 to 2008 (E85/E86 generation). No specific known issue confirmed for this application. We service it to the same standard as our other Z4 sDrive30i rebuilds.
cards.cta: Check Your N52 BMW Z4 sDrive30i

cards.body: A 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-four fitted to the Z4 sDrive30i from 2009 to 2016 (E89 generation). No specific known issue confirmed for this application. We service it to the same standard as our other Z4 sDrive30i rebuilds.
cards.cta: Check Your N20 BMW Z4 sDrive30i

cards.body: A 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-four fitted to the Z4 sDrive30i from 2018 onwards (G29 generation). The B48 is part of BMW's newer modular engine family and is generally well-regarded for reliability. No specific known issue confirmed for this application.
cards.cta: Check Your B48 BMW Z4 sDrive30i

compatibility.intro: Because the Z4 sDrive30i spans three distinct engines across three generations, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an N52 part will work on an N20 car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (N52, N20 or B48) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Z4 sDrive30i quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
